description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Siyambalanduwa, Siyambalanduwa, D/S Division, Monaragala District - Cad. Map No.720005 (24/0147)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration and determinations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules of land parcels, their extents, ownership details, and specific land registration information for multiple properties in the Siyambalanduwa area. The content falls under "Land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) classification.
